name: Delta-Fly Pharma,Inc.
summary: Delta-Fly Pharma, Inc. is a Tokushima-based biotechnology firm, founded in 2010, that develops new oncology medicines. DFP-10917 is in Phase III testing in America and Phase I in Japan for acute myeloid leukemia that has relapsed or resisted treatment; DFP-14323 is in Phase III for lung cancer; and DFP-17729 is in Phase I/II for solid tumors.
